mechanism: Celecoxib inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing berberine plasma concentrations; both agents may increase GI irritation risk and berberine may potentiate antiplatelet effects of NSAIDs.
action: Monitor for increased berberine adverse effects (GI distress, hepatotoxicity); consider dosage adjustment of berberine or alternative NSAID; counsel on GI protection strategies.
